questions.q: What did Michael Pittman Jr. do in Week 1 against the Jacksonville Jaguars?
questions.answer: Michael Pittman Jr. came alive in the second half against the Jacksonville Jaguars and finished with a season-high 97 yards on eight catches, including a 39-yard catch-and-run for a touchdown.

questions.q: How has Michael Pittman Jr. performed since Week 1?
questions.answer: Michael Pittman Jr. has been above 14 PPR points once (Week 3 at Baltimore, a game Gardner Minshew started). Over the past two weeks Pittman has totaled just 12 targets against the Los Angeles Rams and Tennessee Titans for six catches and 67 yards.

questions.q: How does Gardner Minshew target Michael Pittman Jr. compared to Anthony Richardson?
questions.answer: Gardner Minshew is clearly more of a developed downfield thrower than Anthony Richardson and has thrown at Pittman on 26.4% of his routes run including four red-zone targets and an end-zone target. Even last week when Minshew played less than a half Pittman saw a target once every five routes he ran with Minshew.

questions.q: What is the Jacksonville Jaguars' zone coverage rate and rank?
questions.answer: The Jacksonville Jaguars rank fifth with a 77.7% zone coverage rate.

questions.q: How have outside receivers performed against the Jacksonville Jaguars this season?
questions.answer: Outside receivers have been busted up by the Jacksonville Jaguars (over 17.0 yards per catch) last week against Buffalo and two weeks ago against the Texans. An outside receiver has scored at least once against the Jaguars in every game this season, including Michael Pittman Jr. back in Week 1.

questions.q: What does the pan-EU regulation require of digital services and platforms?
questions.answer: It puts a series of governance obligations on digital services and platforms with the aim of ensuring companies are responding to reports of illegal content, and they must also clearly communicate their T&Cs to users and be able to demonstrate proper enforcement.

questions.q: What additional obligations do larger platforms like X have under the pan-EU regulation?
questions.answer: They have additional obligations to identify and mitigate systemic risks such as disinformation, gender-based violence or negative effects on the exercise of fundamental rights.

triples.o: systemic risks such as disinformation, gender-based violence or negative effects on the exercise of fundamental rights

questions.q: What is the crisis response mechanism in the pan-EU regulation?
questions.answer: The regulation includes a “crisis response” mechanism (Article 36) which enables the Commission to adopt rapid-fire measures on larger platforms in situations of “serious threat”, such as war.

triples.o: Commission to adopt rapid-fire measures on larger platforms in situations of serious threat, such as war

questions.q: What false content has been circulating on X since Saturday’s attacks in Israel?
questions.answer: Posts identified as false have been spotted circulating on X — including, in one example, a clip that purported to show Hamas missile attacks on Israel but was actually footage from a video game.

triples.o: false posts, including a clip that purported to show Hamas missile attacks on Israel but was actually footage from a video game

questions.q: What happened to X’s ability to respond internally to reports of content problems after Musk’s takeover?
questions.answer: X’s ability to respond internally to reports of content problems have been drastically pared back after Musk’s takeover last year — which saw major layoffs, including in content moderation and human rights as part of the new billionaire owner’s bid to improve the platform’s profitability.

major layoffs, including in content moderation and human rights
